svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Review pipeline after the change
svg.desc: The osf CLI drives review_run, which asks builder detection for the reviewed range's families. Detection reads commits through the git layer and now consults is_clean_merge for trailer-less merges. Posting fetches the PR diff and anchors inline comments only on lines the diff shows.
